summary: Iteration 12 (portal-aware backend + cross-portal Overview widget) tested end-to-end. Wrote 15 backend pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_portals.py covering /api/dashboard/portals-summary shape, portal= query filter on overview/commission-summary/reconciliation-summary/return-velocity/calculations/discrepancies/recovery/reports/period, POST /calculations/run with portal payload, and upload header-alias missing-columns error. ALL 15 PASSED. UI smoke: login as admin@kazo.com/admin123 works, portal-switcher-select present in header, Cross-Portal Snapshot renders 6 portal tiles (data-testid portal-tile-{code}) with correct KPIs for Myntra (21,614 orders · ₹1,27,02,900 NSV · Expected ₹42,58,108.65) and zeros for the other 5 'coming soon' portals. Clicking Myntra tile persists fundle_portal=myntra in localStorage; switching to amazon via <select> updates localStorage=amazon and Calculations page correctly shows 0 rows. No console errors (only a benign recharts width/height warning during initial mount).

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width(-1)/height(-1) warning on first render — cosmetic only, chart renders fine on relayout.

action_items: Minor: /app/backend/routers/dashboards.py::_apply_portal has dead code — a stray `return {}` after `return q` (lines 29-30). Not functional, but dead branch — clean up for readability.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboards.py _apply_portal helper mutates the passed-in dict and also returns it — but the callers use the mutation, not the return value. Fine but slightly inconsistent style; the dead `return {}` on line 30 is unreachable.

calculations.py _compute_expected_portal correctly delegates to portal fee_heads T1..T5 and case_matrix. Verified endpoint accepts {portal: 'amazon'} without crashing (returns processed=0, total_sales=0 as expected since no Amazon sales seeded).
uploads_r.py required columns now {online_order_id, sku, nsv_val} — confirmed 400 error path returns clear message when headers are absent.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing 21,614 Myntra sales rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 shipped clean. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_portals.py is a regression suite for the portal filter. Cross-Portal Snapshot widget testids: portal-tile-{code} where code ∈ {ajio, amazon, flipkart, myntra, nykaa, tatacliq}. PortalContext localStorage key = 'fundle_portal', default 'all'. Header switcher testid = 'portal-switcher-select'. Any future Amazon parser rewrite should preserve the current alias set — the required columns are only {online_order_id, sku, nsv_val}.
